get.description: Returns all access keys (active and inactive) belonging to the authenticated user. Secret key hashes are never returned.

post.description: Generates a new cryptographically secure access key and secret key pair for the authenticated user. The secret key is returned only once and cannot be retrieved again. Maximum 5 active keys per user.

201.description: Access key and secret key (secret shown only once)

get.description: Returns the count of active and total access keys for the authenticated user, along with the maximum allowed keys.

delete.description: Deactivates an access key (soft delete). Users can revoke their own keys; admins can revoke any key. The key record is retained for audit purposes.

post.description: Authenticates a user with username and password and returns JWT access and refresh tokens.
Revokes the current access token and optionally the refresh token by blacklisting their JTIs.

parameters.description: Optional refresh token to also revoke
parameters.name: request

post.description: Generates a new JWT access token using a valid refresh token.
Creates a new user account and returns JWT access and refresh tokens. Registration must be enabled in server configuration.

get.description: Returns all buckets the authenticated user has access to. Admins see all buckets; regular users see only buckets permitted by their attached policies.

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a new storage bucket. If the bucket already exists in the storage backend, it is linked rather than re-created.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific bucket by name. Requires GetBucketLocation permission.

delete.description: Admin-only. Deletes a bucket and all its objects from both the database and the storage backend.

post.description: Moves all objects under the specified source prefix to a new destination prefix within the same bucket. Cannot move a folder into itself.

200.description: Move result with count of moved objects

get.description: Returns objects stored in the specified bucket. Supports prefix filtering and pagination. For S3-backed buckets, automatically syncs new and removed objects from the storage backend.

parameters.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default 1000, max 1000)
parameters.name: max-keys

post.description: Uploads a file to the specified bucket. The content type is detected from file magic bytes. Requires PutObject permission.

200.description: Upload result with ETag and content type

post.description: Moves an object from one key to another within the same bucket. Requires GetObject, PutObject, and DeleteObject permissions on the respective keys.
Renames an object by changing its filename while keeping it in the same folder. The new name cannot contain slashes. Requires GetObject, PutObject, and DeleteObject permissions.

get.description: Streams the content of an object from the specified bucket. Add ?download=true to force a download attachment. Requires GetObject permission.

parameters.description: Set to 'true' to force download attachment
parameters.name: download

delete.description: Deletes an object and its metadata from the specified bucket. Requires DeleteObject permission.

head.description: Returns HTTP headers with metadata (Content-Type, Content-Length, ETag, Last-Modified) for the specified object without returning the body. Requires HeadObject permission.

get.description: Returns the S3-style access policy document for the specified bucket. Requires GetBucketPolicy permission.

put.description: Admin-only. Sets an S3-style access policy document on the specified bucket. Requires PutBucketPolicy permission.

get.description: Returns all policies for admins, or only the policies attached to the authenticated user for regular users.

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a new IAM-style policy with a validated policy document.
Admin-only. Attaches an existing policy to a user, granting them the policy's permissions.
post.summary: Attach a policy to a user

delete.description: Admin-only. Removes the association between a policy and a user, revoking those permissions.
delete.summary: Detach a policy from a user

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the details of a specific policy by ID.

put.description: Admin-only. Updates an existing policy's name, description, or document. The policy document is validated before saving.

delete.description: Admin-only. Deletes a policy. Fails if the policy is still attached to any users.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns all S3 backend configurations stored in the system.

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a new S3 backend configuration. Credentials are encrypted before storage. If marked as default, any existing default is unset.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns the details of a specific S3 backend configuration by ID.

put.description: Admin-only. Updates an existing S3 backend configuration. New credentials are encrypted before storage. The S3 config cache is invalidated on success.

delete.description: Admin-only. Deletes an S3 backend configuration. Fails if any buckets are currently using this configuration.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns a list of all user accounts in the system.

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a new user account with the specified credentials and role.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

put.description: Updates the email and/or password of the currently authenticated user.

delete.description: Admin-only. Permanently deletes the specified user account.

get.description: Admin-only. Returns all access keys associated with the specified user.
get.summary: List access keys for a user

delete.description: Admin-only. Permanently deletes (hard delete) the specified access key belonging to the given user.

post.description: Admin-only. Locks a user account to prevent the user from logging in. Admin accounts cannot be locked.
Admin-only. Unlocks a previously locked user account to allow login again.

s3_config_id.description: Optional: specific S3 config to use
Optional: specific S3 config to use

sso_email.description: Email from SSO (may differ from Email)
